description: This Java source file defines the 'LogWrapper' class, which wraps Android's native logging utility to support a chainable logging node interface, facilitating flexible log output management within an Android application.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class implementing LogNode that wraps Android's native Log method and supports chaining of log nodes for flexible logging outputs.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs messages to Android's log and forwards the log to the next node if available.
